package telegram

import (
	"context"
	"crypto/sha256"
	"fmt"
	"net/url"
	"strings"
	"time"

	"github.com/google/uuid"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/domain"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/domain/repository"
)

const DefaultLinkTTL = 10 * time.Minute

type TeacherEnsurer interface {
	Execute(context.Context, string) (domain.PersonalTeacher, error)
}

type TokenGenerator interface{ NewID() string }

type Clock interface{ Now() time.Time }

type Service struct {
	Teachers    TeacherEnsurer
	Dialogs     repository.TeacherDialogProvisioner
	Messages    repository.DialogStudentChannelAppender
	Store       repository.TelegramLinkStore
	Tokens      TokenGenerator
	Clock       Clock
	BotUsername string
	LinkTTL     time.Duration
}

func (service Service) IssueLinkCode(ctx context.Context, studentID string) (domain.TelegramLinkCode, error) {
	studentID = strings.TrimSpace(studentID)
	if service.Teachers == nil || service.Dialogs == nil || service.Store == nil || service.Tokens == nil || service.Clock == nil ||
		!validBotUsername(service.BotUsername) {
		return domain.TelegramLinkCode{}, domain.ErrTelegramUnavailable
	}
	teacher, err := service.Teachers.Execute(ctx, studentID)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.TelegramLinkCode{}, err
	}
	binding, err := service.Dialogs.EnsureTeacherDialog(ctx, studentID, teacher.ID, domain.LearningContextGeneral, "")
	if err != nil {
		return domain.TelegramLinkCode{}, err
	}
	code := service.Tokens.NewID()
	if _, err := uuid.Parse(code); err != nil {
		return domain.TelegramLinkCode{}, domain.ErrTelegramUnavailable
	}
	now := service.Clock.Now().UTC()
	ttl := service.LinkTTL
	if ttl <= 0 {
		ttl = DefaultLinkTTL
	}
	expiresAt := now.Add(ttl)
	if err := service.Store.IssueLinkCode(ctx, sha256.Sum256([]byte(code)), domain.TelegramLinkRecord{
		StudentID: studentID, PersonalTeacherID: teacher.ID, DialogID: binding.ID,
		ExpiresAt: expiresAt, CreatedAt: now,
	}); err != nil {
		return domain.TelegramLinkCode{}, err
	}
	return domain.TelegramLinkCode{
		Code: code, BotURL: "https://t.me/" + strings.TrimPrefix(strings.TrimSpace(service.BotUsername), "@") + "?start=" + url.QueryEscape(code),
		ExpiresAt: expiresAt,
	}, nil
}

func (service Service) ProcessUpdate(ctx context.Context, input domain.TelegramInboundUpdate) (domain.TelegramInboundResult, error) {
	update, err := domain.NormalizeTelegramInboundUpdate(input)
	if err != nil || service.Store == nil || service.Messages == nil || service.Clock == nil {
		return domain.TelegramInboundResult{}, domain.ErrInvalidTelegramUpdate
	}
	if code, ok := startCode(update.Text); ok {
		binding, consumeErr := service.Store.ConsumeLinkCode(
			ctx, sha256.Sum256([]byte(code)), update.TelegramUserID, update.ChatID, service.Clock.Now().UTC(),
		)
		if consumeErr != nil {
			return domain.TelegramInboundResult{ReplyText: "Ссылка недействительна или истекла. Создай новую ссылку в приложении."}, consumeErr
		}
		_ = binding
		return domain.TelegramInboundResult{Accepted: true, ReplyText: "Telegram подключён. Здесь отвечает тот же персональный учитель, а история сохраняется в приложении."}, nil
	}
	binding, err := service.Store.GetBindingByChat(ctx, update.TelegramUserID, update.ChatID)
	if err != nil {
		if err == domain.ErrTelegramBindingNotFound {
			return domain.TelegramInboundResult{ReplyText: "Сначала подключи Telegram в настройках персонального учителя."}, err
		}
		return domain.TelegramInboundResult{}, err
	}
	dialogBinding, err := domain.NewTeacherDialogBinding(domain.TeacherDialogBinding{
		ID: binding.DialogID, StudentID: binding.StudentID, PersonalTeacherID: binding.PersonalTeacherID,
		ContextType: domain.LearningContextGeneral,
	})
	if err != nil {
		return domain.TelegramInboundResult{}, domain.ErrTelegramUnavailable
	}
	message, err := service.Messages.AppendStudentChannelMessage(
		ctx, dialogBinding, updateIdempotencyKey(update.UpdateID), domain.DialogMessageChannelTelegram, update.Text,
	)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.TelegramInboundResult{}, err
	}
	if message.Channel != domain.DialogMessageChannelTelegram || message.SenderID != binding.StudentID {
		return domain.TelegramInboundResult{}, domain.ErrTelegramUnavailable
	}
	return domain.TelegramInboundResult{Accepted: true}, nil
}

func startCode(text string) (string, bool) {
	fields := strings.Fields(strings.TrimSpace(text))
	if len(fields) != 2 {
		return "", false
	}
	command := strings.ToLower(fields[0])
	if command != "/start" && !strings.HasPrefix(command, "/start@") {
		return "", false
	}
	if _, err := uuid.Parse(fields[1]); err != nil {
		return "", false
	}
	return fields[1], true
}

func updateIdempotencyKey(updateID int64) string {
	digest := sha256.Sum256([]byte(fmt.Sprintf("telegram-update-v1:%d", updateID)))
	digest[6] = (digest[6] & 0x0f) | 0x50
	digest[8] = (digest[8] & 0x3f) | 0x80
	value, _ := uuid.FromBytes(digest[:16])
	return value.String()
}

func validBotUsername(value string) bool {
	value = strings.TrimPrefix(strings.TrimSpace(value), "@")
	if len(value) < 5 || len(value) > 32 {
		return false
	}
	for _, symbol := range value {
		if (symbol < 'a' || symbol > 'z') && (symbol < 'A' || symbol > 'Z') &&
			(symbol < '0' || symbol > '9') && symbol != '_' {
			return false
		}
	}
	return true
}
